title: Having an equals() method that always returns true or false is not a good idea.
summary: It does not follow the contract of this method. Consider a good default implementation (e.g. this == other). It is in the potential-bugs rule set. detekt runs it by default since 1.2.0.

title: Equals() method is called with null as parameter.
summary: Consider using == to compare to null. It is in the style rule set. detekt runs it by default since 1.2.0.

title: Always override hashCode when you override equals.
summary: All hash-based collections depend on objects meeting the equals-contract. Two equal objects must produce the same hashcode. It is in the potential-bugs rule set. detekt runs it by default since 1.0.0.

title: Classes overriding equals() and hashCode() should use consistent properties across both methods.
summary: It is in the potential-bugs rule set. detekt does not run it by default.
